description: One bounded region measurement request; no defaults or hidden threshold tuning.

image_path.description: Explicitly authorized absolute local regular PNG/JPEG file; final symlinks rejected where O_NOFOLLOW exists; parent links resolve normally.

roi.description: [left,top,right,bottom]; right/bottom exclusive; nonempty, within image; at most 1 million pixels.

rgb_min.description: Decoded RGB lower bounds; no color management.

rgb_max.description: Decoded RGB upper bounds; each >= matching lower bound.

saturation_min.description: Inclusive HSV S threshold: (maxRGB-minRGB)/maxRGB; black S=0.

min_area.description: Retain connected regions with at least this many matched pixels; all discarded regions counted.

connectivity.description: 4 uses shared edges; 8 also joins diagonal neighbors.
